NOSAI PROJECT — THIRD PARTY MASTER INDEX
Version: 2026-09-05
Purpose: single fast lookup for Claude, Cursor and other coding agents.

RULE ZERO
third_party/ is a source/research vault, NOT an execution path.
Before copying/adapting code into src/, verify license + provenance + architecture compatibility + tests.
Never introduce GM/admin/database privileges, secrets, hidden server state, or protection-bypass logic into the autonomous-player runtime.

================================================================================
FAST ROUTING
================================================================================

NEED: NosTale protocol/domain concepts
LOCAL: third_party/sources/opennos/
UPSTREAM: OpenNos/OpenNos
LICENSE: GPL-2.0
USE: packet/domain concepts, emulator architecture, legacy protocol knowledge.
TARGET: NosAi-native adapters/models only after clean adaptation.
DO NOT: blindly copy GPL code into core without licensing decision.

NEED: Modern C#/.NET NosTale architecture
LOCAL: third_party/sources/noscore/
UPSTREAM: NosCoreIO/NosCore
LICENSE: MIT (recorded in project manifests)
USE: modular architecture, networking, persistence, service patterns.
TARGET: src/NosAi.Core/, src/NosAi.Runtime/.
PRIORITY: HIGH.

NEED: Plugin/event/entity architecture
LOCAL: third_party/sources/chickenapi/
UPSTREAM: BlowaXD/ChickenAPI
USE: event system, entity/domain separation, plugin-style modularity.
TARGET: EventBus/domain modules/AcademicEvaluator adapter patterns.
PRIORITY: HIGH.

NEED: Event-driven/distributed emulator patterns
LOCAL: third_party/sources/saltyemu/
UPSTREAM: BlowaXD/SaltyEmu
LICENSE: GPL-3.0
USE: event-driven architecture and modularity as reference.
TARGET: architecture ideas; clean NosAi implementation preferred.

NEED: Navigation/navmesh/pathfinding
LOCAL: third_party/sources/ikpil/DotRecast/
UPSTREAM: ikpil/DotRecast
USE: hierarchical navigation, navmesh, path corridor, obstacle avoidance.
TARGET:
  src/NosAi.Core/Navigation/
  src/NosAi.Runtime/Navigation/
PRIORITY: VERY HIGH for Gate 2 Cognitive Skill Spine.

NEED: Windows human-equivalent input
LOCAL: third_party/sources/inputsimulator/
UPSTREAM: michaelnoonan/inputsimulator
LICENSE: MIT
USE: keyboard/mouse input abstraction patterns.
TARGET: execution adapter behind Guard -> Trust -> Safety.
PRIORITY: HIGH.
RULE: no protection circumvention.

NEED: NosTale client data formats / parser tooling
LOCAL: third_party/sources/taletool/UPSTREAM.md
UPSTREAM: imxeno/taletool
LICENSE: AGPL-3.0
USE:
  Item.dat, monster.dat, Skill.dat, quest.dat, qstprize.dat,
  npctalk.dat, tutorial.dat, map/geometry/cell data parsing.
TARGET:
  external/offline tool -> JSON/artifacts -> NosAi import pipeline.
DO NOT link/copy implementation into core without explicit AGPL decision.
PRIORITY: VERY HIGH for Knowledge Base, QuestGraph and Map Model.

NEED: Structured NosTale reference datasets
LOCAL: third_party/sources/vanosilla-client-files/UPSTREAM.md
UPSTREAM: Vanosilla/client-files
LICENSE: UNKNOWN/UNCLEAR during intake
USE:
  schema/reference for items, monsters, quests, skills, NPCs, maps.
TARGET:
  Knowledge Base import design and validation against exact exam server build.
DO NOT copy dataset into product until licensing/provenance is clarified.
PRIORITY: HIGH as research reference.

NEED: Legacy bot state-machine ideas
LOCAL: third_party/sources/nostale-bot-research/UPSTREAM.md
UPSTREAM: wojtas99/Nostale_Bot
LICENSE: not established
STATUS: QUARANTINED REFERENCE
USE: waypoint/target/loot concepts only.
DO NOT reuse injection or anti-cheat-circumvention implementation.
TARGET: clean NosAi-native skill/state-machine implementations.

NEED: Packet interception/network research
LOCAL: third_party/windivert/
USE: local lab networking/telemetry only when allowed by architecture.
TARGET: observation/research tooling, not hidden execution authority.
RULE: never implement anti-cheat bypass or server-protection circumvention.

NEED: Other existing local research packs
LOCAL:
  third_party/sources/joslat/
  third_party/sources/luxkun/
  third_party/sources/microsoft/
Consult their local provenance/readme before reuse.

================================================================================
NOSAI 3.0 MODULE -> THIRD PARTY ROUTING
================================================================================

Perception / Active Perception
- Prefer Microsoft/Windows capture references already in vault.
- External inference libraries should be consumed as packages where possible, not copied wholesale.

BeliefState / WorldState
- NosCore + ChickenAPI architectural patterns.
- Keep implementation NosAi-native.

Spatial Model / Navigation
- DotRecast first.
- taletool for offline map/cell extraction.
- Vanosilla client-files only as schema/reference unless license is clarified.

Combat Model / Tactical Combat Controller
- OpenNos/NosCore/ChickenAPI for domain vocabulary/reference.
- Vanosilla datasets for research on monster/skill schemas.
- Never use server-only hidden state in the live agent.

QuestGraph / ProgressionEngine
- taletool parser output is preferred.
- Vanosilla client-files is secondary cross-check.
- Goal for academic certification:
  Combat Level 55
  + sufficient Job Level
  + main progression
  + SP1 + SP2 + SP3
  + pet + partner
  + coherent equipment
  + autonomous inventory management.

Character Build Optimizer
- consume Item/Skill/Card/BCard knowledge through version-pinned imported datasets.
- store provenance with every knowledge snapshot.

Skill Library
- use DotRecast for MoveTo/navigation-related skills.
- use InputSimulator concepts for human-equivalent action primitives.
- use ChickenAPI/NosCore patterns for domain/event separation.

Human Pace Governor
- do not reuse bot evasion logic.
- derive timing distributions from consenting human sessions on the same private test environment.

Academic Evaluator
- may use separate server-side ground truth only for scoring/certification.
- evaluator output MUST NOT feed the autonomous player's decision loop.

================================================================================
COMMUNITY SOURCES
================================================================================

LOCAL: third_party/community/RESEARCH_LINKS.md

Reddit/ePvP/forum material is lead/reference material.
Do not copy whole posts or code with unknown provenance.
If community code is useful:
1. identify original repository/author;
2. identify license;
3. pin revision;
4. add provenance;
5. only then vendor/adapt it.

================================================================================
AGENT WORKFLOW — CLAUDE / CURSOR
================================================================================

1. Read this file.
2. Search the listed local third_party path first.
3. Read third_party/manifests/CODE_REUSE_POLICY.md.
4. Read matching provenance/license record.
5. Decide one of:
   REFERENCE_ONLY
   ISOLATED_TOOL
   VENDOR_ALLOWED
   CLEAN_REIMPLEMENTATION
6. Copy/adapt the minimum necessary implementation.
7. Record upstream repository + path + commit/blob + license.
8. Add/update tests.
9. Keep Guard -> Trust -> Safety -> Executor -> Verifier intact.
10. Never introduce privileged server state into Agent Plane.
